propositions: Mutation gate hard-fails with exit code 2 when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent from the checked-out patchset tree due to the change predating the script's introduction
The gate executes its reusable workflow from main against a checked-out patchset that may lack the script, resulting in a Verified -1 that does not reflect the change's actual quality
Sibling gates (env-var registry gate, check_comment_hygiene) already implement file existence guards that skip cleanly with explanatory messages rather than failing
The mutation gate must skip with exit 0 and a descriptive message when scripts/mutation_gate.py is absent, matching the pattern of sibling gates
Changes based at or after the walking-skeleton commit must still execute the gate for real, ensuring the skip does not become a silent bypass on current changes
